import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { activeStorageBlobs } from "../../../backend/schema/active_storage_blobs";

export const activeStorageBlobsCms = customizeTable<typeof activeStorageBlobs>("active_storage_blobs", {
    display: {
        title: "key"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "filename", "serviceName", "key", "contentType", "checksum"],
    fields: {
        key: {
            multiline: true
        },
        filename: {
            multiline: true
        },
        contentType: {
            multiline: true
        },
        metadata: {
            multiline: true
        },
        checksum: {
            multiline: true
        },
        serviceName: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "filename",
        "serviceName",
        "key",
        "contentType",
        "checksum",
        "byteSize",
        "metadata",
        "createdAt"
    ]
});
